purpose: The census that GENERATES the CTRL-04 pin list. Never hand-typed. Required by the advisor before any engine-tier deletion.

advisorClaimsVerified.stateChannelsExist: CONFIRMED. The engine declares rest AND hover AND active per variant, so a rest-only pin would have flattened hover in all three verticals.
advisorClaimsVerified.rottayPathCorrection: CONFIRMED. There is no brand-themes/rottay/ directory; the rottay fixture maps to vertical platform, so the file is brand-themes/platform/index.ts.

advisorClaimRefuted.claim: Deleting an engine --ds-button-ghost-shadow-hover: none FLIPS ghost hover to a soft shadow, because the role floor hover is var(--ds-shadow-sm).
advisorClaimRefuted.measured: FALSE for this tree. ghost/dashed/text/link declare hover and active as var(--ds-button-{variant}-shadow) — a SELF-REFERENCE to their own rest value — not as none. Zero flip hazards found across all variants.
advisorClaimRefuted.consequence: Those four stay internally consistent when their rest falls to the role floor: rest none implies hover none and active none by the self-reference. Their state siblings therefore need no extension.css pin, which makes the pin list materially smaller than the advisor specified.

pinList.note: ai carries var(--ds-shadow-button-rest) and was absent from the advisor six-variant list; it is included here because the census found it.

statesNeedingSeparatePins: Only the variants whose hover/active do NOT self-reference their own rest: primary, secondary, default and ai use var(--ds-shadow-button-hover) at hover; error pins its own value at all three states.
disposition: CENSUS COMPLETE. The pin-and-delete sequence is NOT executed: it edits two out-of-round verticals and its safety rests on a ten-variant x four-state x two-colour-mode computed probe that has not been built.
